The Company’s senior management oversees the management of these risks. Senior management is supported by the Board of Directors
(BOD) that advises on financial risks and the appropriate financial risk governance framework for the Company. BOD provides assurance to
the Company’s senior management that the Company’s financial risk-taking activities are governed by appropriate policies and procedures
and that financial risks are identified, measured and managed in accordance with Company policies and risk appetite. It is the Group’s
policy that all derivative activities for risk management purposes are required to be approved by Board of Directors of Serendib Hotels PLC
(the Immediate Parent Company).
